definitions.explanation: A short, sleeveless, padded jacket worn over other clothing for warmth. It is best known today as the red vest traditionally given to someone celebrating their {還暦|かんれき} (60th birthday).

examples.japanese: ちゃんちゃんこを⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧ので、ちゃんちゃんこを⟦{羽織|はお}った→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧。
examples.english: It was cold, so I put a padded vest over my clothes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{還暦|かんれき}→還暦：05807_kanreki⟧のお⟦{祝|いわ}い→祝い：01838_iwai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧いちゃんちゃんこを{贈|おく}られた。
examples.english: My grandfather was given a red padded vest to celebrate his sixtieth birthday.

notes:
ちゃんちゃんこ is a short, sleeveless padded jacket worn for warmth over other clothes, traditionally by children and the elderly.

CULTURAL NOTE:
A red ちゃんちゃんこ is the traditional gift for someone celebrating ⟦{還暦|かんれき}→還暦：05807_kanreki⟧ (their 60th birthday), since red symbolizes rebirth as the person begins a new 60-year cycle of the zodiac.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ちゃんちゃんこを⟦{着|き}る→着る：00541_kiru⟧/⟦{羽織|はお}る→羽織る：13901_haoru⟧: to wear/put on a padded vest
- ⟦{赤|あか}→赤：02842_aka⟧いちゃんちゃんこ: the red vest given at ⟦{還暦|かんれき}→還暦：05807_kanreki⟧
